in-ap-recruitment.notes: Original-backed draft research, awaiting review. Forest Range Officers brief 16/2026 dated 15 September announces four provisional direct-recruitment vacancies; permanent tenure is not established. Original online dates 16 October–5 November 2026, 23:59 close; governing timezone unknown and corrected in pending draft. Detailed notification is due by 16 October and must replace brief extraction before opening. Degree must exist as at detailed-notification date; physical standards, age, nationality and domicile await that notice. Page 3 requires English AND Telugu separately at SSC Standard, 50 marks each, plus walking/Medical Board and separate qualifying Computer Proficiency Test. SSC Standard is not CEFR. Passing language tests cannot establish application or appointment eligibility. Current browser register matches brief link; reader failed. One existing draft and exact retained originals remain pending; no new collection or health timestamp.

in-ct-recruitment.notes: Original-backed draft research, awaiting review. Advertisement 05/2026 dated 8 September covers separately applied Food Laboratory and Drug Laboratory Microbiologist posts, three plus two vacancies, direct recruitment and gazetted Class II; permanent tenure not established. Original online dates 10 September noon–9 October 2026 at 23:59; governing timezone unknown and corrected in both pending drafts. Correction periods do not reopen initial applications. Page 1 invites Indian citizens and Government of India recognized categories; complete foreign-national routes need verification. State domicile controls benefits, not blanket nationality permission. Page 17 gives Hindi/English paper medium, not a formal proficiency level. Written/interview routes and conditional interview marking need full review. Current browser archive/original readable, reader failed; two existing drafts remain unapproved, with no new source-health timestamp.
